question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg_composition AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
    AND month_year != ''
  GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
  FROM monthly_avg_composition
),
monthly_top_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_composition as max_idx_composition
  FROM monthly_max_interest
  WHERE rn = 1
),
monthly_top_with_name AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.month_year,
    mt.interest_id,
    mt.max_idx_composition,
    im.interest_name
  FROM monthly_top_interest mt
  JOIN interest_map im ON mt.interest_id = im.id
  ORDER BY mt.month_year
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    max_idx_composition as max_index_composition,
    AVG(max_idx_composition) OVER (
      ORDER BY month_year 
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_avg_3mo,
    LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as name_1mo_ago,
    LAG(max_idx_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as max_idx_1mo_ago,
    LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as name_2mo_ago,
    LAG(max_idx_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as max_idx_2mo_ago
  FROM monthly_top_with_name
)
SELECT * FROM final_result ORDER BY date
